title: Maria's Clothes
text:
Today it is cold and rainy. Maria wears a blue coat, a red scarf, and black boots. She also takes an umbrella because the sky is grey.

Tomorrow the weather will be sunny and warm. Maria will wear a white T-shirt and blue jeans. She does not need her coat or her boots.

questions.text: What color is Maria's coat today?

options: A white T-shirt and blue jeans
A blue coat and black boots
A red scarf and an umbrella

questions.text: Why does Maria take an umbrella today?
options: Because it is likely to rain
Because she wants to go swimming

questions.text: How will the weather be different tomorrow?
options: It will be warmer and sunnier
It will be colder and snowier
It will be windy and dark
It will be the same as today

vocabulary.definition: a long piece of cloth worn around the neck to keep warm
an object you hold above your head to stay dry when it rains
full of sunshine; bright with sun
strong shoes that cover the foot and part of the leg

paragraph_translations: Hoy hace frío y llueve. María lleva un abrigo azul, una bufanda roja y botas negras. También lleva un paraguas porque el cielo está gris.
Mañana el tiempo será soleado y cálido. María llevará una camiseta blanca y unos vaqueros azules. No necesita su abrigo ni sus botas.
